scripts.build: rm -rf docs && rm -rf dist && tsc && pnpm run docs
scripts.push-commit: f() { git add -A && git commit -m "${1:-chore}" && pnpm push; }; f
scripts.push: f() { pnpm version patch --no-git-tag-version --no-git-checks && pnpm build && pnpm publish --tag release-0.1 --no-git-checks && version="v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git add -A && git commit -m $version && git tag -a $version -m $version && git push origin v0.1.x --follow-tags; }; f
